clauses.requirement: The test method described in Annex 11 shall be applied to vehicles in the configuration "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid".
The ESA state during tests shall be as specified in Annex 19 paragraph 2 (heading for the ESA test configuration requirements).

During the tests the ESA shall be in configuration "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid"; the SOC of the traction battery shall be kept between 20 per cent and 80 per cent of maximum SOC during the whole frequency range measurement (the measurement may be split into sub-bands, discharging the traction battery before the next sub-band); if the test is not performed with a REESS, the ESA should be tested at rated current; if current consumption can be adjusted, it shall be set to at least 80 per cent of maximum rated charging/input current for AC charging; for DC charging it shall be set to at least 20 per cent of nominal value, or to a minimum of 16 A if 20 per cent cannot be achieved in the test facility, unless another value is agreed with the Type Approval Authorities.
The test arrangements shall comply with Annex 19 paragraph 3 (heading for test arrangement requirements).

Artificial networks used for measurement on the vehicle shall be the AMN(s) defined in Appendix 8 paragraph 4 for AC power lines and the DC-charging-AN(s) defined in Appendix 8 paragraph 3 for DC power lines; they shall be mounted directly on the ground plane with their cases bonded to it; conducted emissions on AC and DC power lines shall be measured successively on each line by connecting the measuring receiver to the measuring port of the related AMN/DC-charging-AN, with the measuring ports of the networks in the other power lines terminated with a 50 Ω load; the AMN(s)/DC-charging-AN(s) shall be placed in front, aligned and on the same side of the vehicle power charging plug; CISPR 16-1-4 may be used.
The measuring location may be a shielded enclosure, an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) or an open area test site (OATS) complying with the requirements of CISPR 16-1-4.
The test set-up (floor-standing equipment) for connecting ESAs in configuration "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid" shall be as shown in Figure 1 of Appendix 1 to Annex 19.

Measurements shall be performed with a spectrum analyser or scanning receiver using the parameters defined in Table 1 and Table 2; spectrum analysers and FFT-based instruments meeting CISPR 16-1-1 may be used for conformity measurements; FFT-based instruments shall continuously record and evaluate the signal during the measurement time, with a minimum measurement time of 1 s per analysis frequency band (real-time mode) of the FFT instrument.
